Players Committee card image of [[Margo (Errata)]] (PC-E1 image; no errata mark), printing: “Once during opponent's deploy phase, may use 1 Force to choose: 'break cover' of opponent's Undercover spy here or draw destiny; if destiny = number of opponent's characters at same site, to initiate battle here this turn requires +1 Force.” Uploaded unchanged.
